timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹93.38 Cr; net profit ₹11.13 Cr (+38.8% YoY).
Manba Finance reported FY26 AUM of ₹1,713 Cr with net profit rising 20.1% YoY to ₹45.4 Cr.

Manba Finance Limited shared the earnings conference call recording link for Q4 FR FY2026 results discussion on May 19, 2026, available at www.manbafinance.com/financial-information/call-audio-recordings.
Manba Finance held its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call on May 19, 2026, reporting an AUM growth of 29% to ₹1,713 Cr and guiding 25-30% annual growth.
Manba Finance announced strategic partnerships with AMU Leasing and SHFIN to drive EV adoption and rural financing.

On 19 October 2026, Manba Finance shareholders passed all seven EGM resolutions, including the increase in authorised share capital and a preferential issue of fully convertible warrants and equity shares.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹97.74 Cr, net profit ₹13.73 Cr (+20.4% YoY).
Board of Directors declared an Interim Dividend of Rs.0.25 per equity share, payable on 20 November 2026.
